actions_english.prompt:
Respond with detailed but simple instructions in English. Each line must consists of only one action, where the mentioned objects must be items from the following list: ['cabinet right door', 'cabinet left door', 'top drawer', 'cabinet', 'stove on the left', 'stove on the right', 'counter top on the left', 'counter top on the right', 'top drawer space', 'pot lid', 'pot body', 'pot bottom', 'stove knob on the right', 'stove knob on the left', 'kitchen sink', 'faucet handle', 'fridge', 'fridge door', 'fridge shelf', 'chicken leg', 'salt shaker', 'pepper shaker', 'fork'].

    Currently, you can see the following objects: ``the pot lid is on the pot body,
the pot body is on the counter top on the right,
the cabbage is on the counter top on the left,
the chicken leg is on the fridge shelf,
the salt shaker is in the cabinet,
the pepper shaker is in the cabinet,
the fork is in the top drawer space,
cabinet right door is fully closed,
cabinet left door is fully closed,
top drawer is fully closed,
fridge door is fully closed,
stove knob on the right is turned off,
stove knob on the left is turned off,
faucet handle is turned off''
Use the following contexts for creating your action sequence:
How to Choose a Dishwasher
How to Be an Efficient Restaurant Dishwasher
How to Use a Dishwasher
1. Loading the Dishwasher
1.1 If you simply toss dirty dishes in your dishwasher, they will not come clean. Before placing your dishes in the washer, run them under tap water from the sink to remove bits of food, condiments, and other substances. This dishes do not have to be completely polished before you place them in the sink. However, they should be free of excess food before washing.

actions_string.prompt:
Actions: Open fridge door.
Open cabinet left door.
Open top drawer.
Take fork from top drawer space.
Place fork under faucet handle.
Turn on faucet handle.
Run pot body with pot lid under faucet handle.
Place pot body with pot lid on counter top on the right.
Take chicken leg from fridge shelf.
Place chicken leg under faucet handle.
Turn off faucet handle.
Primitives: 
actions = 
[
'pick(<obj>)': it contains one argument. The robot must have an empty hand to pick up an object.
'place(<obj>, <surface>)': it contains two arguments.
'sprinkle(<obj>, <container>)': it contains two arguments. There must be no object placed on top of the container.
'stir(<container>, <obj>)': it contains two arguments. There must be no object placed on top of the container.
'chop(<obj>, <utensil>)': it contains two arguments.
'open(<joint>)': it contains one argument.
'close(<joint>)': it contains one argument.
'nudge(<door>)': it contains one argument. This action is applied to open a door even wider.
'turn-on(<knob>)': turning on a stove knob, it contains one argument.
'turn-off(<knob>)': turning off a stove knob, it contains one argument.
'turn-on(<handle>)': turning on a faucet handle, it contains one argument.
'turn-off(<handle>)': turning off a faucet handle, it contains one argument.
], 


    The primitive actions include argument types. Please use these objects in the respective types: {  '<appliance>': [],
   '<button>': [],
   '<condiment>': ['salt shaker', 'pepper shaker'],
   '<door>': ['cabinet right door', 'cabinet left door', 'fridge door'],
   '<drawer>': ['top drawer'],
   '<food>': ['chicken leg'],
   '<joint>': [  'cabinet right door',
                 'cabinet left door',
                 'top drawer',

                 'faucet handle',
                 'fridge door'],
   '<knob>': [  'stove knob on the right',

                'faucet handle'],
   '<movable>': [  'pot lid',
                   'pot body',
                   'chicken leg',
                   'salt shaker',
                   'pepper shaker',
                   'fork'],
   '<region>': ['pot body'],
   '<space>': ['cabinet', 'top drawer space', 'pot body'],
   '<surface>': [  'stove on the left',
                   'stove on the right',
                   'counter top on the left',
